wire.t: Jalen Hurts is on season-ending injured reserve, and Tanner McKee will start for Philadelphia. Hurts sits on the IR for StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte, which has Drake Maye (31.94 in Week 7) and a lot of tight ends.

Lamar Jackson has missed three games with an ankle injury, and Tyler Huntley is still starting for Baltimore. FantasyPros has him still out, while Yahoo reports he is expected to play Buffalo in Week 8. He belongs to The Champ.
Davante Adams ruptured his hamstring and Sean McVay gave a 6-10 week timeline. Adams is on IR for The Champ.
Jaylen Waddle left Week 7 against Arizona with an injury and his Week 8 status is unclear. Jefferson’s Reserve started him and got 7.8.

Aaron Jones hurt his knee late in Minnesota's Week 7 win over Indianapolis and is questionable, with Jordan Mason looking like the better option. Both belong to Bourbon Lover; Mason scored 8.3 and Jones 2.6 in the lineup.
Jaylin Noel (turf toe) went down in Houston's 2-OT loss to the Giants and has the Week 8 bye to recover. StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte started him and got 0.7.

Bill_Buttlicker traded Omar Cooper Jr., Devaughn Vele and Konata Mumpfield with Catfan94's 2029 first-round pick moving the other way: JAY2913 gets Cooper, Bill_Buttlicker gets Vele, Mumpfield and the pick.
Breece Hall (quad) sat out Week 7 for the fourth straight game and is a possible return in Week 8 against the Raiders. He belongs to Catfan94’s Farm Team.

stories.title: Hold My DK is 7‑0 with nobody left to play, and still owns zero 2027 or 2028 firsts
stories.dek: TheMoneyTeam2302 put up 149.60 on Catfan94’s Farm Team. The future is somebody else's problem.
body: Hold My DK beat Catfan94’s Farm Team 149.60 to 139.58 in Week 7, and nobody on the roster has a game left. Caleb Williams had 26.62, Christian McCaffrey had 21.0 and Jaylen Warren had 19.2 in the flex. Derrick Henry had 6.4 and DK Metcalf had 7.1. It didn't matter.

That makes seven wins for a team that went 5-9 in both of its previous seasons as TheMoneyTeam2302's. The roster is old on purpose: McCaffrey (30), Henry (32), George Kittle (33), Patrick Mahomes (31) and Aaron Rodgers (42). Rodgers had 15.58 in the superflex.

The cost is still on the books. TheMoneyTeam2302 owns no picks in the first three rounds of the 2027 draft and none in 2028. Tyler Warren, Rashee Rice and Brian Robinson Jr. are all out, and it hasn't mattered yet.

The league record is only official after Monday night, but this one's done. Hold My DK is going to be 7-0 with a 149.60 and Catfan94’s Farm Team gets the loss. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix, the only team with a better all-play, is next door at 152.38 with one game left.

stories.title: Bill_Buttlicker sold Omar Cooper Jr. for two receivers and a 2029 first, and now owns 12 firsts
stories.dek: The site owner picked up Catfan94's 2029 first-round pick. He also won Week 7, for now.
body: On Sunday Bill_Buttlicker sent Omar Cooper Jr. (22) to JAY2913 for Devaughn Vele, Konata Mumpfield and Catfan94's 2029 first-round pick. That's a rookie receiver who put up 21.0 in the Week 7 lineup for a 28-year-old, a 24-year-old and a pick.

He now owns 12 first-round picks in the next three drafts: five in 2027 (TJohn91's, jrsmith1391's, JAY2913's, paknight12's and Catfan94's), four in 2028 (his own, TJohn91's, Br0phy's and TheMoneyTeam2302's), and three in 2029 (his own, BTaylor1's and Catfan94's). His own 2027 first still belongs to Br0phy.

And the lineup? StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte has 98.64 against I Chase Brown Kids' 85.94, with Javonte Williams from the Dallas game still to play for I Chase Brown Kids. Drake Maye had 31.94, and the flex was Jaylin Noel with 0.7.
A win would be a first win over a good team. Bill_Buttlicker is not the commissioner here. He's a guy with a website and, apparently, a lot of firsts.

stories.title: Three Week 7 games are still alive on Monday night
stories.dek: CeeDee Lamb, Javonte Williams and George Pickens can all still move a result.
body: Kraft for Cash trails The Champ 113.32 to 108.02 with CeeDee Lamb still to play for Kraft for Cash. Lamb has 0.0 so far. In a 0.5 PPR league he needs about 5.3 points to flip it. That's five catches for 53 yards, give or take.
I Chase Brown Kids trails StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 98.64 to 85.94 and has Javonte Williams (0.0) left. He needs about 12.7 points. Bill_Buttlicker has a lead that is not safe.
LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix leads OBJAY 152.38 to 148.76 with George Pickens (0.0) the last man standing. Pickens would have to go negative by more than 3.6 points for JAY2913 to steal it.
Bourbon Lover also has Dak Prescott (0.0) left against Asian Jim's 119.04. Bourbon Lover has 92.68 and needs a 26.4-point night from the superflex.

stories.title: The Champ left 37.0 from Tony Pollard on the bench and is still ahead
stories.dek: TJohn91 also started Nico Collins for 1.6. Two titles will do that to you.
body: In Week 7 Tony Pollard scored 37.0 for The Champ. He was on the bench, the biggest bench score in the league this week. Matthew Golden scored 7.4 in the flex.
Colston Loveland (21.4) and Josh Jacobs (20.1) were also on the bench. That's 78.5 points sitting there. The lineup that did play had Nico Collins (1.6), Garrett Wilson (4.1) and Sam LaPorta (3.3).
It might still be enough. The Champ has 113.32 and Kraft for Cash has 108.02, with CeeDee Lamb left. Bucky Irving gave 26.5 and Jared Goff gave 21.02.

The depth is also why TJohn91 can afford it. Davante Adams is on IR with a ruptured hamstring and a 6-10 week timeline, and Lamar Jackson has been out three games. Reports have Jackson back for Week 8 against Buffalo. 4-2 and the defending champ is still in this.

feature.title: Week 6: Hold My DK survives, and StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte doesn't
body: Hold My DK beat Kraft for Cash 135.40 to 131.54 to stay unbeaten. Christian McCaffrey had 28.2 and Aaron Rodgers had 20.02 in the superflex. Chuba Hubbard's 22.1 sat on the bench. It was the closest game of the week, and TheMoneyTeam2302 keeps winning those.
LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix had the top score again, 155.04 over Asian Jim. Isaiah Likely had 25.9 in the flex and Jordan Love had 22.74 in the superflex. Michael Penix Jr. scored 28.1 on the bench.

Jefferson’s Reserve beat StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 136.32 to 88.50. Trevor Lawrence had 35.34 and C.J. Stroud had 28.98. Bill_Buttlicker got 30.3 from Drake Maye, zero from Juwan Johnson in the flex, and 40.5 from Omar Cooper Jr. and Jaylin Noel on the bench.
And Bourbon Lover scored 74.14, the low of the week, against OBJAY. Mark Andrews had 1.9 at tight end. paknight12 is 1-5.

columns.title: HOLD MY DK IS 7‑0 AND NOBODY EVEN HAS A PLAYER LEFT
columns.dek: 149.60 and the game's over. The future is still a LIE.
body: SEVEN AND OH! Okay, almost. Hold My DK beat Catfan94’s Farm Team 149.60 to 139.58 and THERE IS NOBODY LEFT TO PLAY. TheMoneyTeam2302 is going to be undefeated and everybody in the league is going to have to hear about it!
Caleb Williams put up 26.62! Christian McCaffrey put up 21.0! Jaylen Warren, in the FLEX, put up 19.2! Derrick Henry had 6.4! HE'S 32! WHO CARES!
And he STILL has no picks in the first three rounds of 2027 and none in 2028! THE MORTGAGE IS REAL AND IT'S BEAUTIFUL!
But LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix has the better all-play, 52-14 to 51-15! Catfan94 has 152.38 with one man left! THE UNBEATEN TEAM ISN'T THE BEST TEAM! SOMEBODY CALL SOMEBODY!

columns.title: Bill_Buttlicker finally made a trade I understand
columns.dek: He sold a rookie for two bodies and a 2029 first. He also owns 12 firsts now. Do something with them.
body: Bill_Buttlicker sold Omar Cooper Jr. to JAY2913 for Devaughn Vele, Konata Mumpfield and Catfan94's 2029 first-round pick. Cooper scored 21.0 for him in the Week 7 lineup. Fine. Sell the guy at the top. I get it.
Now he owns 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts. Five in 2027, four in 2028 and three in 2029. His own 2027 first belongs to Br0phy, so there's no reason to tank.
He's 9-25 all time, 2-4 this year, and he's leading I Chase Brown Kids 98.64 to 85.94 with Javonte Williams to play. A win would be nice. A plan would be nicer.
Use some of these picks on players who are good now. Drake Maye had 31.94 this week. Build around him. The rest of the roster had a Juwan Johnson problem. Go fix it.

columns.title: How to spend 12 first-round picks, by Holden McGroin
columns.dek: Bill_Buttlicker now has twelve. I now have twelve ideas.
body: 1. Trade all twelve for Aaron Rodgers. He's 42. That's three and a half times as old as the average first-round pick on the day it's used, which makes him three and a half times as good.
2. Never trade a pick for a player who scores 21.0. Omar Cooper Jr. scored 21.0 on Bill_Buttlicker's roster. That's a pick-eater. Get rid of him. Oh. He did. Good job.
3. Pick the 2029 draft first. It's three years from now, which is also how long it will take Bill_Buttlicker to win a playoff game. It'll all line up.
4. Draft a kicker with every pick. This league doesn't start kickers, so you're the only team that cares.
5. Name the team "Twelve Firsts and a Prayer." TJohn91 did it with The Champ, and I assume the prayer worked for him.

columns.title: Hold My DK is undefeated. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix is better.
columns.dek: All-play, points for, and a 243.58 that should have won a trophy by itself.
body: Hold My DK is 6-0 with 950.24 points and a 51-15 all-play. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix is 5-1 with 970.94 points and a 52-14 all-play. By both measures, Catfan94 has the better team.

Expected wins from all-play: 51-15 is 4.6 expected wins for TheMoneyTeam2302, who has six. That's about 1.4 wins of good fortune, the most in the league. Catfan94's 52-14 is 4.7 expected wins, and he has five.
The close games tell the story. Hold My DK beat Asian Jim by 6.92 and Kraft for Cash by 3.86. Those go the other way about half the time.

Then there's 243.58, the highest score in league history, 45 points clear of second place. My model says LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix is the favorite. My model has never seen a man start Aaron Rodgers in the superflex and win six straight, though.

exits.t: Scored 37.0 on the bench in Week 7, the biggest bench score in the league, while TJohn91 started Matthew Golden at flex for 7.4. Wants a lineup that knows his name.
Scored 26.42 on the bench again in Week 7. Fourth on the depth chart behind Josh Allen, Jordan Love and Malik Willis. He'd like to be third.
Scored 22.7 on the bench in Week 7 while Christian Watson put up 9.7 in the lineup. Catfan94’s Farm Team lost by 10.02.
Scored 22.0 on the bench in Week 7 while Jalen Coker had 1.4 in the lineup. Kraft for Cash trails The Champ by 5.30.
Scored 20.3 in the flex for the second week running and the team is 0-6. The best player on the field every week and still losing. He's asking around.

facts: TJohn91 has won both titles on Sleeper. He went 12-2 in 2024 and 10-4 in 2025.
Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts, the most in the league. JAY2913 is next with six.
Catfan94's 243.58 in Week 5 this year is the highest score in league history by 45 points.
Bill_Buttlicker went 3-11 in 2024 and 4-10 in 2025, and scored 54.86 in 2024 Week 3, the second-lowest score in league history.
